title: fix(metadata-protocol,rest,runtime)!: a name only disabled packages hold answers 404 at `_env`, and its package-less customization is withheld (ADR-0150 D3, D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_

Fixes #33385
Fixes #33401

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

**BREAKING** for a read of an environment customization (a package-less row) of a name whose every holding package is disabled: the bare read and the execution read answered the row (200) and now answer 404 as if it were not saved; re-enabling the package serves it again. `_env` of such a name moves from 409 naming the disabled packages to 404. No migration: nothing stored changes (ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, in the changeset).

The claim declared `Clause-②: no`. The declaration self-check reads the #33401 withhold (served 200 to 404) as a narrowing and finds no widening: the `_env` move replaces one refusal with another. So this body and the changeset declare `no (narrowing)`. #33646's `yes (narrowing)` was for a diff that both widened and narrowed. The deviation is reported to the seat.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:某个元数据名称的所有持有包都被停用时,`/meta/:type/_env/:name` 在两个入口(REST 与 runtime)从 409(点名被停用的包)改为 404;环境里对这些包的名称做的无包定制(含包从未发布的语言版本)在停用期间不再被读出,重新启用后原样恢复。
- **为什么改**:停用包是运维处理冲突的常规手段,但 `_env` 仍然报冲突并点名已停用的包,裸读还在返回属于已停用包的定制内容;#32183 第 17 行(R4-B2)与 #32814 的席位裁决要求按"什么都没存"作答。
- **风险与回滚**:只改读路径判定,不删数据;若某个启用包只通过未水合的存储行持有该名称,`_env` 仍保持 main 的 409(已钉住并做消融)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts`(`packagelessRowWithheldHolder`)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`(`admitEnvironmentQualifier` 给"仅停用持有者"的拒绝打标记)、`packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.ts` 与 `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`(`admitEnvironmentAddress`:标记的拒绝仅在裸读不返回条目时放行为 404)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts`,预期 353 个测试全部通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One judgment, shared by both cards: a name whose every holder is disabled answers as if nothing were stored. That covers the bare read (served and execution faces), its `/layers`, and `_env` on both transports. A disabled package's customization is never served, and nothing stored is touched.

- **#33401**, `protocol-meta-item-face.ts`: the read naming no package now also withholds a **package-less** row it reached when the row's key is held only by disabled packages (`packagelessRowWithheldHolder`). The key's holders come from the registry's one owner rule, `overlayRowBinding` with every holder counted (seat ruling 6882483833 on #32814: ownership counts every holder, disabled included).
  - `null` is the environment's own item (D3 (a)) and is served.
  - One holder: withheld when that holder is disabled.
  - Two or more: judged as the name's holders are (`disabledOnlyHolderOf`).
  - Member grain is not part of the key, so a locale the holder never shipped is withheld too.
- **#33385**: `admitEnvironmentQualifier` (`protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`) still refuses a name only disabled packages hold. It is synchronous, it reads no stored rows, and its declared signature lives in `protocol.ts`. The refusal now carries a registered-symbol mark (`objectstack.metadata-protocol.disabledHoldersOnlyRefusal`, the same pattern as the face's `storedRowHoldersRefusal`), set only after the read it would admit has passed the 501 judgment.
  - Each `_env` door handles the mark in `admitEnvironmentAddress`: `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`.
  - If the read naming no package (`getMetaItem`) withholds the name, the door admits `_env`, and the read answers 404 naming no package.
  - If that read serves an item, or refuses, an enabled package holds the name through a stored row the registry has not read, and the 409 stands, as on main.
- `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`: read only. H3 holds: `overlaySlotBinding` counts every composite holder, so a package-less row of a disabled holder's key binds to that holder, and `getEnvironmentScopedItem` answers `undefined` for it.
- The PM's H2 was half true. Without a mark, the `_env` read never reached the face as `_env`. Admitting on the registry alone would have served an enabled package's unhydrated stored row at `_env`. The mark plus the door's bare-read check closes that without touching `protocol.ts`.

| Read | State | FROM (origin/main 1e65a389, measured) | TO |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `GET /meta/:type/_env/:name`, REST and runtime, all 18 `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` | only holder disabled, no row | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the disabled holder | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, naming no package |
| same | only holder disabled, a package-less registry row of the name | 409 naming it | 404 |
| same, `dashboard` `email_template` `permission` `report` | only registry holder disabled, an enabled package's unhydrated stored row the bare read serves | 409 | 409 (unchanged, CONTROL) |
| same, the other 14 types | same fixture; their bare read serves no row of that shape | 409 | 404, as their bare read |
| protocol `admitEnvironmentQualifier` (objectql pin, row 17) | the only holder disabled | 409 naming X | 409 naming X, marked; the bare read withholds, so both doors answer 404 |
| bare `GET /meta/email_template/:name?member=fr-FR` and the execution read | the only holder disabled, a package-less stored row of a locale it never shipped (stored, or stored and hydrated), both registration orders, disabled before or after | 200, the row | the holder's withheld item (404), equal to the answer with no row stored |
| same | two holders, both disabled | 200, the row | withheld |
| `_env`, bare read | the holder re-enabled | 409 naming it / the row | unchanged |
| bare read, `/layers` | package-less row at a member the holder ships | 404 | 404 (unchanged, CONTROL) |

The served-to-404 rows are narrowings (hence `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, the `!` title and the BREAKING banner). The `_env` rows replace one refusal with another (409 to 404). No answer widens.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts` (the face's shared real-registry harness; the area seat approved this file-surface extension):
  - The R4-B2 `_env` pin now asserts the marked 409 plus the withheld bare read. An unmarked-with-the-holder-enabled CONTROL is added beside it.
  - New top-level `[#33401]` describe, the bare read at a never-shipped locale: four orders on both faces with re-enable as CONTROL; the answer with the row stored equals the answer with none; two holders both disabled, then both re-enabled giving the read's own 409; the hydrated row.
  - CONTROLs: an enabled holder, the environment's own item, and a row at a shipped member.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`, for every `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` type:
  - `_env` answers 404 beside the other addresses' 404; re-enabled, the 409 naming the holder (CONTROL).
  - A package-less registry row: the bare read, `/layers` and `_env` answer 404; re-enabled, the 409.
  - The unhydrated stored-row CONTROL, with the four row-serving types named explicitly so its 409 leg cannot pass vacuously.
  - Both harnesses' engine doubles now answer `find` from stored rows (empty unless a pin stores one); `findOne` stays main's `null`.
- Ablations: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold`. Each mutate leg on metadata-protocol was rebuilt and `ablation-dist-preflight` returned 0; each restore leg was rebuilt, `--absent` returned 0, and the restore was proved blob == HEAD.
  - #33401 arm removed (at 71880ceb, face unchanged since): objectql 7 red of 319, all seven moved cells; every CONTROL green.
  - The mark removed: objectql 1 red of 320, the row 17 pin. rest 50 red of 353 and runtime 50 red of 363: 18 types times 2 404-pins, plus the 14 non-row-serving types' 404 leg.
  - The door's withheld check removed: rest 4 red of 353 and runtime 4 red of 363, exactly the four row-serving types' 409 CONTROL.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not reachable, so not pinned:** the action case the ruling names, a package-less action on another object being the environment's own item. On origin/main, the bare `GET /meta/action/:name` read stamps such a registry row with the disabled holder's envelope (`_packageId` of that holder), so the face withholds it (404) both before and after this PR. Stored action rows are not read by that door. Reported as a finding. The face's new arm defers to the registry's `(object, name)` key through `overlayRowBinding`.
- The `_env` door asks the bare read once more before it answers a marked refusal. That costs one extra protocol read, and only on the disabled-only path.

## Verification

Code head `00d7daf5`; `4c288478` changes only the changeset's `Clause-②` line. Every run is on a shared box, so wall-clock figures are not idle-box figures.

- Full suites:
  - metadata-protocol: 341 passed, 9 skipped files; 22894 passed, 43 skipped tests.
  - objectql: 597 files, 13170 tests.
  - rest: 417 files; 8778 passed, 355 skipped.
  - runtime: 609 files; 12349 passed, 19 skipped.
- At `00d7daf5`, after `findOne` went back to main's `null`:
  - `src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts` 353/353 and `src/domains/meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts` 363/363. The row-holder CONTROL still reads the row served by the bare read, so its 409 leg is not vacuous.
  - rest and runtime `typecheck` exit 0, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
</details>
